speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflation and flattened diaphragms, combined with your chronic cough, white phlegm, and dyspnea, are classic signs of COPD.
